description: HR++ double glazing with low-e coating and argon fill
source: Real Dutch label-B/C refurbished stock is HR++ (U 1.1-1.2). TABULA's published R for this measure is 0.556 (U 1.80, plain HR glazing), which reflects the market when the NL typology was compiled rather than what a building refurbished to this tier has installed today.
